notable_absence.finding: The Prerequisites' single role sentence is worded 'the bucket where you want to create the index' - even though the Procedure it gates explicitly branches into importing either an index OR an alias ('Add Index' vs '+ Add Alias'). The page never separately states whether importing an alias requires the same Search Admin role, a different one, or whether 'the bucket' even has a single well-defined referent for a global (multi-bucket) alias import - the same ambiguity already flagged on create-search-index-alias-rest-api.md in this same batch for alias creation via REST. The wording gap recurs at every surface (UI import, REST create) where an alias's bucket-scoped role requirement is stated using index-only language.

cross_component_finding: See export-search-index.json (this same batch) for the shared search:search-index-definition-json artifact and the export/import scope asymmetry: import explicitly supports both an index and an alias definition, while export's own Procedure and role wording never mentions an alias at all. Additionally, this page's Procedure step 6 sends the reader to TWO different next pages depending on which artifact they imported (customize-index.md for a plain index, create-search-index-alias.md for an alias) in a single sentence - a real branch in the task, correctly reflected here as two offersConfigurationChoice relations plus two seeAlso relations from one piece of source text.
